result_preview.title: Incident & Safety Analytics Hub
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates and analyzes incident and safety data across manufacturing operations.
result_preview.description: This data product aggregates incident and safety incident records throughout the production lifecycle to provide comprehensive safety metrics and compliance insights. It summarizes trends in workplace incidents, hazardous events, and safety violations to enable proactive risk mitigation and regulatory compliance monitoring. The hub provides actionable analytics on incident patterns, root causes, and safety performance indicators across all manufacturing facilities.

result_preview.title: Incident and Safety Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates incident and safety event data with compliance metrics and trend analysis.
result_preview.description: This data product aggregates production incidents and safety incidents across manufacturing operations, providing comprehensive analytics on incident frequency, severity distribution, and safety compliance metrics. It summarizes incident patterns by equipment, location, and shift, enabling root cause identification and proactive safety risk mitigation to support continuous improvement in workplace safety performance.
